ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a horizontal dielectric interface passing through the origin, with the x axis marked on the right as pointing to the right, and the z axis pointing downward. The medium above the interface is labeled εr = 1.0, and the medium below is labeled εr = 4.5. The incident wave is directed from the upper medium toward the origin, the reflected wave still propagates in the upper medium toward the upper right, and the transmitted wave enters the lower medium and propagates toward the lower right. In the figure the transmission angle relative to the normal in the z direction is marked as 19.2°, and H_i, H_r, H_t are represented by dot symbols as being out of the plane, so the electric field E is in the x-z plane of incidence. Then reason: From the figure it can be known that the wave is incident from εr1 = 1.0 to εr2 = 4.5. The refractive indices are n1 = 1, n2 = sqrt(4.5). From Snell's law n1 sin θi = n2 sin θt, taking θt = 19.2°, gives sin θi ≈ sqrt(4.5) sin(19.2°) ≈ 0.70, therefore θi ≈ 45°, and the reflection angle θr = θi ≈ 45°. Since H is perpendicular to the plane of incidence and E is parallel to the plane of incidence, use the TM Fresnel reflection coefficient, with magnitude |Γ_TM| ≈ 0.23. The wavelength λ = 600 μm = 6 × 10^-4 m, so in the upper medium β1 = 2π/λ = π × 10^4 / 3 rad/m. The reflected wave propagates along the +x and -z directions, therefore k_r = (β1/sqrt(2))(a_x - a_z), and the phase factor is exp[-j β1(x - z)/sqrt(2)]. The direction of the reflected electric field perpendicular to k_r is taken, according to the method specified in the problem, as (a_x + a_z)/sqrt(2). Therefore the reflected electric field is 0.23 E0/sqrt(2) (a_x + a_z) exp[-j π×10^4(x-z)/(3sqrt(2))] V/m.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一条水平分界面，右侧标出上半空间介质的相对介电常数为 εr=1.0，下半空间介质的相对介电常数为 εr=4.5。x 轴沿界面向右，z 轴竖直向下。入射波从上方介质射向原点，反射波留在上方介质并向 +x、−z 方向传播，透射波进入下方介质并向 +x、+z 方向传播。图中还标出透射波方向与竖直法线的夹角为 19.2°，并且 Ei、Er、Et 分别与各自传播方向垂直，属于 TM 极化。

推理：上半空间为空气-like 介质，所以 β1=2π/λ。给定 λ=600 μm=6×10^-4 m，因此 β1=2π/(6×10^-4)=π×10^4/3 rad/m。下半空间 εr=4.5，故 β2=β1√4.5。由界面切向相位匹配，kx=β2 sin 19.2°≈β1/√2。反射波在上方介质中传播，切向分量仍为 +x，法向分量相对于入射法向分量反号，因此 k_r=(β1/√2)(a_x−a_z)。于是 k_r·r=(β1/√2)(x−z)=π×10^4(x−z)/(3√2)。

对 TM 波使用平面波关系 H=(1/η) k_hat×E，并在 z=0 界面处施加切向 Ex 与 Hy 连续。用 η1=η0，η2=η0/√4.5，并结合图中透射角 19.2°，可得反射电场幅度相对于入射电场幅度约为 0.23。反射电场方向必须与 k_r 垂直，并按图中给定的反射电场极化方向取为 (a_x+a_z)/√2。因此反射电场为幅度系数 0.23 乘以 E0，再乘以极化单位矢量和相位因子 exp[-j k_r·r]。

推理：上半空间为空气-like 介质，所以 β1=2π/λ。给定 λ=600 μm=6×10^-4 m，因此 β1=2π/(6×10^-4)=π×10^4/3 rad/m。下半空间 εr=4.5，故 β2=β1√4.5。由界面切向相位匹配，kx=β2 sin 19.2°≈β1/√2。反射波在上方介质中传播，切向分量仍为 +x，法向分量相对于入射法向分量反号，因此 k_r=(β1/√2)(a_x−a_z)。于是 k_r·r=(β1/√2)(x−z)=π×10^4(x−z)/(3√2)。

对 TM 波使用平面波关系 H=(1/η) k_hat×E，并在 z=0 界面处施加切向 Ex 与 Hy 连续。用 η1=η0，η2=η0/√4.5，并结合图中透射角 19.2°，可得反射电场幅度相对于入射电场幅度约为 0.23。反射电场方向必须与 k_r 垂直，并按图中给定的反射电场极化方向取为 (a_x+a_z)/√2。因此反射电场为幅度系数 0.23 乘以 E0，再乘以极化单位矢量和相位因子 exp[-j k_r·r]。

raw_record.original_question: A monochromatic plane wave of wavelength \(\lambda = 600 \, \mu m\) is propagating in the direction shown in the figure below. \(\vec{E}_i\), \(\vec{E}_r\), and \(\vec{E}_t\) denote the incident, reflected, and transmitted electric field vectors associated with the wave. What is the expression for the reflected electric field vector \(\vec{E}_r\)?
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: In the figure there is a horizontal dielectric interface passing through the origin, with the x axis marked on the right as pointing to the right, and the z axis pointing downward. The medium above the interface is labeled εr = 1.0, and the medium below is labeled εr = 4.5. The incident wave is directed from the upper medium toward the origin, the reflected wave still propagates in the upper medium toward the upper right, and the transmitted wave enters the lower medium and propagates toward the lower right. In the figure the transmission angle relative to the normal in the z direction is marked as 19.2°, and H_i, H_r, H_t are represented by dot symbols as being out of the plane, so the electric field E is in the x-z plane of incidence.

Then reason: From the figure it can be known that the wave is incident from εr1 = 1.0 to εr2 = 4.5. The refractive indices are n1 = 1, n2 = sqrt(4.5). From Snell's law n1 sin θi = n2 sin θt, taking θt = 19.2°, gives sin θi ≈ sqrt(4.5) sin(19.2°) ≈ 0.70, therefore θi ≈ 45°, and the reflection angle θr = θi ≈ 45°. Since H is perpendicular to the plane of incidence and E is parallel to the plane of incidence, use the TM Fresnel reflection coefficient, with magnitude |Γ_TM| ≈ 0.23. The wavelength λ = 600 μm = 6 × 10^-4 m, so in the upper medium β1 = 2π/λ = π × 10^4 / 3 rad/m. The reflected wave propagates along the +x and -z directions, therefore k_r = (β1/sqrt(2))(a_x - a_z), and the phase factor is exp[-j β1(x - z)/sqrt(2)]. The direction of the reflected electric field perpendicular to k_r is taken, according to the method specified in the problem, as (a_x + a_z)/sqrt(2). Therefore the reflected electric field is 0.23 E0/sqrt(2) (a_x + a_z) exp[-j π×10^4(x-z)/(3sqrt(2))] V/m.
